verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a self-serve sandbox that is completely separate from production, with per-product simulations and no real money involved. It is AI-native: the CLI defaults to sandbox and requires an explicit `--prod` opt-in, and the Developer MCP endpoint (mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com) lets agents create test resources, simulate events and call sandbox endpoints. The Quickstart also walks through an end-to-end sandbox payment. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and sandbox coverage of Connected Account APIs, which are excluded.
